By means of the present application under Section 483 Cr.P.C., the applicant has sought for a suitable direction to the learned Judicial Magistrate-II, Gorakhpur to consider and decide Criminal Case No. 44190 of 2022 (State of U.P. Vs. Indrajeet Verma and others) arising out of Case Crime No.
